senses.gloss: m. (Ispe. noun of אסם = חסם, v. חִיסּוּם, the h. equiv. of our w.) forging steel, steel-edge.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 62b:1">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>כא׳ לפרזלא</he> (Ms. M. <he>אסטימא</he> read <he>אִסְטוּמָא</he>, Ms. O. <he>סטומא</he>, Var. <cite ref="A01411"><he>אִצְ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="A01411"><he>אִיצְ׳</he></cite>) what the steel edge is to the iron.

senses.gloss: a word in a charm formula.
